01
The club

Tough training.
Warm welcome.

Hard Knox is a volunteer amateur boxing club in Richmond — run by people who love the sport and love seeing what it does for people.

Hard Knox Boxing is led by Chrissy Gillespie — a former national champion who has spent years coaching in the Nelson–Tasman region, from young fighters chasing Golden Gloves titles to adults just wanting to get fit.

The club is part of the Boxing New Zealand whānau, affiliated through the Nelson Association, and it runs events like Fight 4 Rangatahi — giving local young people a stage to test themselves.

And it’s not just about fighters. Hard Knox runs a weekly class for adults with disabilities in Richmond — boxing for confidence, coordination and community, led with care.

All abilities

Beginners, experienced, fighters — and a dedicated class for adults with disabilities.

Volunteer-run

A community club, not a business. People give their time because they care.

Real coaching

Led by a former national champion with years in the corner.

Local events

Fight 4 Rangatahi nights that bring the whole region together.
